simple.meaning: תָּוָה (tâvâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to mark out , i.e. (primitive) scratch or (definite) imprint.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּוָה (H8427).
